risks.basis: THIS FILE has a confirmed defect on record
risks.risk: tests/server_wins_hydration.js's UNGUARDED-overwrite detector shipped as a regex that could NEVER match. The backreference `` -- which is what makes the pattern mean 'the RHS is the same variable whose .id is the key', i.e. an overwrite rather than a seen-set -- was authored through a shell heredoc that consumed the backslash and left a raw 0x01 control byte. The pattern read `= <control-byte>`, matched nothing, and the arm asserting that NOBODY hydrates with an unguarded overwrite passed on every file vacuously. That arm exists because sairnsenior was found shipping four hydrates in exactly that state, invisible to the additive detector; a vacuous version of it reports the whole platform clean. Caught by the push gate's control-byte check, which is precisely the failure mode its own message describes. Fixed by building the pattern with explicit escapes and giving it a two-direction fixture.
